A few useful answers

Before we begin.

What kind of clients do you work with?

Compass works with local and national organizations across health, wellness, entertainment, hospitality, professional services and consumer brands.

Can you handle both strategy and production?

Yes. The team can define the direction, develop the identity or campaign, produce content and support ongoing execution.

Do you work in Spanish?

Yes. Compass is bilingual and can support English- and Spanish-language brand communication.

Can we start with one project?

Absolutely. A focused identity, campaign, video or website project can be the beginning of a longer partnership—or stand on its own.
